title: Working now and drumming seated
summary: He works once or twice a week and sits low on a chair with a pillow.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: How often do you work nowadays?

Well, sometimes twice a week, sometimes once a week. Sometimes once a week, huh? It's been slow though, since Carnival's been slow. It's been slow since Carnival. You can work once a week nowadays, you're doing well. I'll tell you one thing. I see them drummers just about that high, and I can't sit that high and play golf or nothing. I was going to ask about that. I got sick, I got sick, high. And that's it. I can't go, I see some colors stand up. They almost stand up to play the big. I can't do it. I tried. I even bought them one of those chairs.
What do you have there, a little seat, a folding seat in there, do you like? Just a pillow.
You sit on an ordinary chair like that. I have a chair with a pillow. With that little pillow. I see. And I never get tired of my legs.
